command: import copy,hashlib,http.server,json,threading from pathlib import Path from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright from tools.demo import produce,render from scripts.evidence import identity,manifest out=Path('.local-runs/adversarial-inspector');produce(out) trace=json.loads((out/'trace.json').read_bytes());native=copy.deepcopy(trace['trace']) marker='' trace['trace'].append({'label':'Hostile display fixture (not native output): '+marker,'response':{'display_fixture':marker}}) trace['adversarial_display_fixture']={'native_rows':len(native),'fixture_rows':1,'fixture_is_native_output':False} (out/'trace.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(trace,indent=2)+'\n').encode()) (out/'report.html').write_bytes(render(trace['trace'],trace['source_sha256']).encode()) handler=lambda *args,**kwargs:http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler(*args,directory=str(out),**kwargs) server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),handler) threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True).start() views=[] try: with sync_playwright() as runtime: browser=runtime.chromium.launch(executable_path='C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe',headless=True,chromium_sandbox=True) for view,width in [('desktop',1440),('mobile',390)]: page=browser.new_page(viewport={'width':width,'height':900}) page.goto(f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/report.html',wait_until='load') assert page.locator('script,iframe,object,embed,img').count()==0 assert not page.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth') rows=page.locator('tbody tr') assert rows.count()==len(native)+1 for index,item in enumerate(native): assert json.loads(rows.nth(index).locator('pre').inner_text())==item['response'] assert marker in rows.last.inner_text() page.keyboard.press('Tab');assert page.locator(':focus').get_attribute('href')=='#trace' page.keyboard.press('Enter');assert page.locator(':focus').get_attribute('id')=='trace' page.screenshot(path=str(out/(view+'.png')),full_page=True) with page.expect_response(lambda response:response.url.endswith('/trace.json')) as observed: page.get_by_role('link',name='Raw observations').press('Enter') assert observed.value.status==200 and observed.value.json()==trace views.append({'view':view,'width':width,'escaped_fixture_visible':True,'active_injected_nodes':0,'keyboard_skip_verified':True,'raw_link_response_verified':True}) page.close() browser.close() finally: server.shutdown();server.server_close() result={'status':'PASS','source_sha256':identity(manifest()),'html_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'report.html').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'native_rows':len(native),'fixture_rows':1,'fixture_is_native_output':False,'views':views,'scope':'Actual
